title: Mediator must consider relevant factors
description: Mediator must consider rights and obligations of parties, usages of trade, circumstances giving rise to dispute and other relevant factors

content.what: shall have regard to the rights and obligations of the parties, the usages of trade, the circumstances giving rise to the consumer dispute and such other relevant factors
conditions: a consumer dispute is referred for mediation by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission
limitations: shall be guided by the principles of natural justice while carrying out mediation
